practice_summary.text: I'm ready to begin! Please let me know which piece to place first and at what position on the grid.
Can you give me some guidance on what our objective is please?

Our objective is to recreate a specific target pattern on the 6x6 grid using the patterned pieces you have in your staging area (pieces ID 0–23). Since I can't see the target pattern, I need you to guide me on which piece to place and where. If you can describe or show the target pattern, I can follow your instructions step by step to match it as closely as possible. What should I place first?
Place the piece in the upper left of the grid on the upper left of the target
I've placed the light yellow horizontal striped piece (ID 0) in the upper left corner of the grid at position (0, 0). What would you like me to do next?
Place the piece that has a pink backround and 5 wavy lines directly below the one we have already placed
I've placed the piece with a pink background and 5 wavy lines (ID 1) directly below the piece in the upper left corner, at position (0, 1). What would you like me to do next?
Place the piece that has a yellow background and 4 black lines crossing in an aterix shape, below the one we have just placed

I've placed the piece with a yellow background and 4 black lines crossing in an asterisk shape (ID 15) directly below the pink piece with 5 wavy lines, at position (0, 2). What would you like me to do next?
Place thepeice that is a gird of back lines on a white background to the right of the first piece we placed
I've placed the piece with a grid of black lines on a white background (ID 11) to the right of the first piece, at position (1, 0). What should I do next?
Rpleace the first piece that we placed with the spiral
I've replaced the first piece in the upper left corner with the black spiral piece (ID 7). The light yellow horizontal striped piece has been moved back to the staging area. What should I do next?
The spiral is incorrect. Use the spiral that is in the upper left, with a thinner line spiral, that starts on the right of the shape, and initially moves upwards and to the left.

I've replaced the current spiral piece in the top left (0, 0) with the thinner spiral piece (ID 6) that starts on the right and initially moves upwards and to the left. Please let me know if this is correct or what you'd like next!
Thats correct, all good, we're moving on
Great! The top left pattern is all set. Please let me know which piece to place next and where you'd like it to go on the grid.

turns.text: Trial 1
The board is currently empty and I can see all 24 patterned pieces available for placement. Please let me know which piece you'd like to place first and where on the grid you want it to go.
Move the piece that consists of black diagonal lines on a white background, to the upper left position
I've placed the white tile with a few bold thick black diagonal lines rising to the right (ID 3) in the upper left position at (0, 0). I'm not sure this is the right one.
Incorrect. replace with diagonal black lines, that go from upper left to lower right.

I've replaced the previous piece with the white tile with a few bold thick black diagonal lines falling to the right (ID 20) in the upper left position at (0, 0). Please let me know what you'd like next!
Place the spiral piece with a heavy balck line, below the piece we have just placed.

I've placed the pale-pink tile with a single thick, bold black spiral winding counter-clockwise (ID 7) directly below the diagonal lines piece in the upper left position, at (0, 1). What would you like me to do next?
Place the piece that has 3 black horizontal lines of 3 different gauges below the one we have just placed

I've placed the white tile with three horizontal lines, a thin faint middle line between a thick top and a thicker bottom (ID 16) directly below the spiral piece, at position (0, 2). What would you like me to do next?
Place the piece that has a yellow background and 6 black horizontal lines immediately to the right of the one we have just placed

I've placed the yellow tile with thin vertical lines (ID 18) immediately to the right of the white tile with three horizontal lines, a thin faint middle line between a thick top and a thicker bottom (ID 16) at position (1, 2). I'm not entirely sure this is the right one.
Incorrect. Replace the piece that you have just placed with a piece with yellow background and horizontal lines. The lines must be horizontal.

I've replaced the yellow tile with thin vertical lines (ID 18) with the yellow tile with straight black horizontal lines (ID 0) at position (1, 2). Please confirm if this is correct or let me know the next step!
Trial 2
The board is empty and I see all 24 pieces available. Please tell me which piece (describe the pattern or give the ID) you want placed first and where on the grid it should go.
Place the peice that has a white background and black diagonal lines going from upper left to lower right, in the upper left of the target area
I've placed the white tile with a few bold thick black diagonal lines falling to the right (ID 20) in the upper left position of the grid. What would you like me to do next?
Place the piece that has a white background and a heavy black spiral immediately to the right of the piece we have just placed

I've placed the pale-pink tile with a single thick, bold black spiral winding counter-clockwise (ID 7) immediately to the right of the diagonal line piece at position (1, 0). What would you like me to do next?
Place the iece that has a yellow background and a number of black horizontal lines immediately to the right of the piece we have just placed
I've placed the yellow tile with straight black horizontal lines (ID 0) immediately to the right of the heavy black spiral at position (2, 0). What would you like me to do next?
Place the piece that has a white background and 3 lines directly below the first piece we placed. Note that the correct piece has 2 black lines, and one grey.
I've placed the white tile with five thin horizontal lines, every other line indented from the left (ID 23) directly below the first piece at position (0, 1). What would you like me to do next?
Last piece incorrect. The required piece has ony 3 lines. Of these 3 lines, both the upper and lower are black, while the middle one is grey. This piece goes below the first piece we placed.
I've placed the white tile with thin straight black vertical lines (ID 8) directly below the first piece at position (0, 1). I'm not entirely certain this is the right choice.
Still incorrect. Place the piece that has 3 horizontal lines below the first piece we placed.
